sum: Nyxoah SA, a medical technology company, focuses on the development and commercialization of solutions to treat obstructive sleep apnea. Its lead solution is the Genio system, a hypoglossal neurostimulations therapy for obstructive sleep apnea. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Mont-Saint-Guibert, Belgium.
ceo: Mr. Liam J. Kelly (Chief Executive Officer)
